title: Regulatory audit export and supervisory evidence delivery
workflow: Authenticate audit or supervisory evidence request and legal authority
Review proportional subject, date, jurisdiction and document scope
Freeze reproducible source snapshots and effective reporting policy
Generate secure evidence package with observed original data and provenance
Measure hash, export time, access expiry and chain of custody
Record delivery receipt and follow-up corrections without overwriting prior export
invariants: A generated supervisory report does not prove regulatory compliance
Audit export must not include unrelated institution customer data
Only qualified authorized reviewers can approve sensitive disclosures
Exported amounts must reconcile to authoritative journal and reporting policy
Document provenance must distinguish observed source from legal interpretation
No fabricated regulator receipt, audit pass or cryptographic signature
Correction requires distinct version and prior export reference
acceptance_tests: Changing exported bytes fails integrity check
Source cursor permits reproduction of report
independent_gate: Competent authority verification, privacy/legal approval, signed evidence policy and actual export integrity tests.
